# Significance table (generated by scripts/162_significance_table.py — do not edit by hand)

Realised gain of each deployable signal minus random's on test units, in loss units and as a share of the all-cheap loss. The interval is the 95% paired unit bootstrap over every draw (1,000 draws, none dropped; `statistics_hardening.csv`, section `paired_gain`). nDG and its interval are the official ones, under the 25% prize filter. Ego speed is scored through the same protocol and has no official nDG row.
